key.name: allow-screen-blanking
key.description: Let GNOME blank and lock the screen normally while Keep Awake prevents automatic suspend.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: Show the Keep Awake icon in the top panel when the mode is active.

key.name: prevent-external-sleep
key.summary: Prevent sleep with an external monitor
key.description: Prevent automatic suspend in Standard mode while an external monitor is connected.
